body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity. Subject: Viscosities. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Its subject is Fully deployed concrete pump, showing outriggers and boom in use while receiving concrete. Maximum aggregate size is 2 cm and below.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity。画面主体：Viscosities。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动10系列混凝土泵的理论输送量写成21 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成23 MPa。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. Hopper capacity is 0.1 m³. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Main-unit weight is 400 kg.
body.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成21 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成23 MPa。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Maximum aggregate size is 2 cm and below. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。最大骨料粒径 2 cm and below。

body.en: On the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. Main-unit weight is 400 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.1 m³.

question.en: What output does the Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 电动10系列混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 21 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是21 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity.
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是23 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viscosity画面里印出的数字。
